definition: the first month of the year in the modern calendar
hook: Every January, you walk through a doorway named after a two-faced god.
modernAnchor: January is just month one to us. New year, fresh start, the calendar clicks over.

origin.originalMeaning: the month of Janus, god of doorways and beginnings

journey: Janus was the Roman god of gates, doorways, and transitions, shown with two faces looking opposite ways.
One face stared into the past, the other into the future, the perfect keeper of any threshold.
The Romans set his month at the hinge of the year, where the old one closes and the new one opens.
To cross into a new year was to step through the god's doorway, looking back and ahead at once.
